rules.text: a shadda is never transparent to the skeleton: a geminated radical occupies exactly ONE written letter position, never two -- writing it as two base letters does not reconstruct the surface
a GEM slot matches the written letter exactly like an ordinary radical slot; the doubling itself is a SEPARATE licence, checked only after the shape has matched

the licence requires an EXACT declared environment: the bound slot/radical, and a shadda source VERIFIED against the actual written surface at the GEM slot's own letter position -- a caller's assertion that the source is written_shadda is never sufficient by itself; an unpointed surface, or one whose shadda sits on the wrong letter, buys nothing and the token abstains shadda_not_in_surface

the licence is keyed to the template+slot's ATTESTED evidence basis, never to the literal letter that fills the radical position -- an ordinary Form II root over any R2 (not only ر) is licensed exactly like any other, given the same declared environment and an attested basis; nothing is licensed by default, and an unattested basis abstains gemination_realization_unlicensed regardless of which letter fills R2

triliteral doubling/gemination and quadriliteral templates are DISTINCT families: this pack declares no R4 slot, and inc-quadriliteral-templates declares no GEM slot, so the two never collide by construction

mood (indicative/subjunctive/jussive) and cross-clitic-boundary idgham are impossible category errors for these two templates and are never consulted: fa33ala_perfect_active is a PERFECT-tense verb form (مبني -- it carries no mood inflection at all; mood only exists on the imperfect) and mufa33il_active_participle is a noun; neither template declares a clitic layer a merger could cross either. The doubled-ROOT جزم alternation (a geminate root genuinely losing its written doubling in the jussive, e.g. لم يَمْدُدْ from يَمُدُّ) is a DIFFERENT phenomenon over a different root/template family this pack does not declare -- conflating it with Form II's inherent, mood-invariant gemination was the recorded defect

this pack is a narrow RIVAL to cu-voice-melody-templates/cu-passive-voice-vocalization (inc-voice-melody-templates' letter-identical f2_perfect_active/f2_perfect_passive rows) and to inc-derivatives' mu_participle (the same مُـ+radicals skeleton): every one of these packs independently requires its own genuinely WRITTEN mark before resolving the same cell, so an unpointed Form II shape abstains under all three -- never a candidate under one pack while a rival abstains. This pack's own ownership is narrow: it licenses ONLY the doubling itself once a shape has already matched; it never resolves voice, never distinguishes participle from place/time noun, and never derives an un-geminated variant

templates.name: Form II active participle, R2 geminated (مُفَعِّل)
